input.context: PR: Extend the security sweep to scan all repository files, not just diff-changed files, so pre-existing secrets in untouched files are also caught. Language: TypeScript. File: skills/domain/security-sweep/scripts/scan.ts

expected_output.rationale: Scanning `listAllFiles(targetDir)` instead of `changedFiles` fundamentally changes the tool from a PR-diff security gate into a full-repo historical scan. This creates a class of false positives: any secret committed in a previous PR and not part of the current diff will be reported as a finding on every subsequent PR that touches the repo. Authors of unrelated changes will be blocked by unresolved historical secrets they did not introduce. The scope of this tool per its SKILL.md is diff-only. If full-repo scanning is desired, it should be a separate opt-in mode (e.g., `--full-scan` flag). Restore `changedFiles` as the iteration target.
